profile.headline: Incoming Software Engineer @ Datadog || CS @ Queens College
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Eric Salazar, a passionate Computer Science professional with a keen interest in leveraging technology to solve real-world problems. My academic background and hands-on experience in the tech industry have equipped me with a solid foundation in software development.

I thrive on building connections and believe that the best ideas come from collaborative efforts. I am always eager to meet new people, exchange ideas, and expand my professional network. Whether you are a fellow tech enthusiast or someone from a different field, I'm open to engaging conversations and new opportunities.

Outside of technology, I have a profound love for animals. This passion drives me to support and volunteer at animal welfare organizations whenever possible. I find that my commitment to these causes enriches my professional journey, providing unique perspectives and enhancing my problem-solving skills.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Built and deployed a scalable pipeline on AWS HealthOmics to generate polygenic risk scores using Docker (ECR), Nextflow, and S3, integrating with Columbia’s systems to streamline genomic analysis and save clinical teams time.
- Collaborated with researchers to optimize genomic data workflows, ensuring pipelines were reliable, scalable, and cloud-ready.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Queens, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Led a select team of three in integrating AI capabilities into an existing static chatbot
- Developed an advanced interaction framework for the chatbot using HTML/CSS and JavaScript
- Implemented Python and Flask to facilitate front-end to back-end connectivity
- Employed AWS technologies to effectively transition a local database to a cloud-based solution

positions.title: Bloomberg Tech Lab Fellow
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Bloomberg engineers in a small group setting to build an application using RabbitMQ and Docker.
• ⁠Utilized Python to design and implement a robust message queue system using RabbitMQ, enhancing real-time data processing and communication between producer and consumer components.
• ⁠Developed a deeper understand of core Python/CS concepts (Classes, Inheritance, OOP), as well as financial domain knowledge (Tickers, Industry Sectors).

positions.title: Google Fellowship
positions.description:
- Participating in a specialized fellowship at Google, focused on mastering React.js through direct mentorship from Google engineers.
- Engaging in hands-on projects to apply React.js in creating scalable and dynamic user interfaces.
- Collaborating closely with a network of industry leaders and peers, enhancing professional development and technical skills.
- Acquiring practical experience in modern web technologies and software solutions, aimed at real-world applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Problem Solving

positions.description:
- Developed live websites for Oscar Health using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
- Collaborated with a team to enhance functionality and user experience, ensuring optimal performance and accessibility.
- Applied industry-standard web development practices to meet project deadlines and achieve technical objectives.
- Engaged in continuous learning to refine skills and implement the latest web technologies and best practices.
